survey_design.weight_fields_interpretation: This country note is a descriptive OECD indicator profile for Türkiye based on Education at a Glance 2025. It does not provide an analytic student-level dataset, sampling frame, or microdata extraction steps, so student/sampling weights and replicate-weight procedures are not applicable to the note’s presentation. The figures and indicators are reported as population-level statistics (e.g., unemployment rates by educational attainment, expenditure per student, completion rates) rather than model-based estimates from a user-replicable survey analysis. For any underlying indicator methodology, readers are directed to the Education at a Glance 2025 Sources, Methodologies and Technical Notes and the OECD Handbook for Internationally Comparative Education Statistics, which specify how each indicator is constructed and how comparability across countries is ensured.

data.handling_not_reported_explanation: The document is a descriptive country note summarising education-system indicators (attainment, unemployment, wages, enrolment, completion, expenditure, instruction time) rather than an empirical analysis predicting student outcomes from ILSA cognitive achievement scores. Plausible Values are therefore not applicable because no PV-based achievement modelling is conducted in this note. Missing-data handling is not reported because the note does not describe any student-level analytic dataset or estimation procedure; instead, it points to separate OECD technical documentation for indicator construction.

sample_details.sample_filtering_criteria: This is a Türkiye country note that reports OECD Education at a Glance 2025 indicators using the latest available reference years. No student-level analytic sample is defined in the note; it does not specify inclusion/exclusion criteria, assessment-module restrictions, or completion filters because it does not conduct a microdata-based statistical model.

data.outcome_summary: This OECD Education at a Glance 2025 country note for Türkiye provides descriptive statistics across multiple education-system dimensions, with emphasis on tertiary education. It reports trends in educational attainment and labour-market outcomes (e.g., unemployment rates for 25–34 year-olds by educational attainment), educational participation and progression (e.g., age-for-grade in lower secondary, bachelor’s completion rates, dropout after first year, international student mobility), and financial resources (e.g., government expenditure per student by education level and as a share of GDP). It also summarises learning-environment and organisation indicators such as compulsory instruction time, class size, and the allocation of instruction time to core subjects. The note does not present an ML or PV-based modelling framework, does not define a student analytic sample, and does not report model performance metrics; instead, it directs readers to the Education at a Glance 2025 technical notes for indicator construction and comparability.
data.null_fields_interpretation: This extraction corresponds to an OECD country note that summarises indicator results rather than an empirical study with an ML pipeline. As a result, there is no student-level dataset, no PV generation/combining procedure, no missing-data strategy for an analytic model, and no ML algorithms or predictive targets to extract. The absence of sample sizes and weighting variables reflects the document’s descriptive reporting purpose and its reliance on separate OECD technical documentation for the underlying indicator methodologies.
